meaning.en: Supply cannot keep up with demand.
meaning.zh: 供应不能满足需求。

examples.zh: 新款手机一上市就供不应求。
examples.en: The new phone sold out as soon as it launched.

examples.zh: 这种药供不应求，很多医院买不到。
examples.en: The drug is in short supply and many hospitals can't get it.

examples.zh: 春节前车票供不应求。
examples.en: Before Spring Festival there aren't enough tickets to go round.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于商业、新闻。

meaning.en: Clearly evident; plain to see.
meaning.zh: 非常明显，很容易看清。

examples.zh: 显而易见，他在撒谎。
examples.en: It's obvious he's lying.

examples.zh: 这个方案的缺点显而易见。
examples.en: The flaws in this plan are plain to see.

examples.zh: 这是一个显而易见的错误。
examples.en: This is an obvious mistake.

usage.zh: 常放句首：显而易见，……

meaning.en: All the streets and lanes; everywhere in a town.
meaning.zh: 城镇里所有的街道和小巷，泛指各处。

examples.zh: 这首歌火遍了大街小巷。
examples.en: The song is a hit all over town.

examples.zh: 春节期间，大街小巷张灯结彩。
examples.en: At Spring Festival every street and alley is decorated with lanterns.

examples.zh: 我们走遍了大街小巷，也没找到那家店。
examples.en: We searched every street and lane but couldn't find the shop.

usage.en: Common in 传遍/火遍大街小巷.
usage.zh: 常说“传遍（火遍）大街小巷”。

meaning.en: Easy to imagine or infer.
meaning.zh: 可以通过推想而知道。

examples.zh: 连老师都不会，学生的困难可想而知。
examples.en: If even the teacher can't do it, you can imagine how hard it is for the students.

examples.zh: 他没复习就去考试，结果可想而知。
examples.en: He took the exam without revising; you can guess the result.

usage.en: Predicate; often 结果可想而知.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“结果可想而知”。

meaning.en: Uniting in mind and effort.
meaning.zh: 思想一致，共同努力。

examples.zh: 大家齐心协力，终于完成了任务。
examples.en: Everyone pulled together and the job was finally done.

examples.zh: 只要齐心协力，就没有克服不了的困难。
examples.en: If we work as one, no difficulty is insurmountable.

examples.zh: 全村人齐心协力修好了路。
examples.en: The whole village joined forces to repair the road.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. Also 同心协力.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语。也作“同心协力”。

meaning.en: Uniquely favoured by nature or circumstance.
meaning.zh: 具备的条件特别优越。

examples.zh: 这里得天独厚的气候适合种茶。
examples.en: The uniquely favourable climate here is ideal for tea.

examples.zh: 他有得天独厚的嗓音条件。
examples.en: He was blessed with a naturally fine voice.

examples.zh: 这座城市的地理位置得天独厚。
examples.en: The city's location is uniquely advantageous.

usage.en: Usually attributive: 得天独厚的条件 / 优势.
usage.zh: 多作定语：得天独厚的条件（优势）。

meaning.en: Falling in love at first sight.
meaning.zh: 第一次见面就产生了爱情。

examples.zh: 他们在火车上一见钟情。
examples.en: They fell in love at first sight on a train.

examples.zh: 我对这座城市一见钟情。
examples.en: I fell in love with this city the moment I saw it.

examples.zh: 你相信一见钟情吗？
examples.en: Do you believe in love at first sight?

usage.en: Also for things (对这件衣服一见钟情).
usage.zh: 也可用于物。

meaning.en: To struggle hard under difficult conditions.
meaning.zh: 在艰难困苦的条件下奋发努力。

examples.zh: 老一辈人艰苦奋斗，才有今天的好日子。
examples.en: The older generation's hard struggle gave us today's good life.

examples.zh: 创业初期，他们艰苦奋斗了五年。
examples.en: In the early years of the business they struggled hard for five years.

examples.zh: 要发扬艰苦奋斗的精神。
examples.en: We must carry forward the spirit of hard struggle.

usage.en: Official language; often 艰苦奋斗的精神 / 作风.
usage.zh: 官方用语，常说“艰苦奋斗的精神（作风）”。

meaning.en: Doing the same thing at the same time without prior agreement.
meaning.zh: 事先没有约定而彼此一致。

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，大家不约而同地笑了起来。
examples.en: Hearing the news, everyone burst out laughing at once.

examples.zh: 两个人不约而同地选了同一本书。
examples.en: Both of them happened to pick the same book.

examples.zh: 全场观众不约而同地站了起来。
examples.en: The whole audience rose to their feet as one.

usage.zh: 作状语：不约而同地……

meaning.en: Intensive preparations in full swing.
meaning.zh: 锣鼓敲得很急，比喻正式活动前的紧张准备。

examples.zh: 晚会的筹备工作正在紧锣密鼓地进行。
examples.en: Preparations for the gala are in full swing.

examples.zh: 新校区建设紧锣密鼓。
examples.en: Construction of the new campus is going flat out.

usage.en: Usually 紧锣密鼓地进行 / 筹备. From opera, where fast drums precede the action.
usage.zh: 常说“紧锣密鼓地进行”。源自戏曲开场前的锣鼓。

literal: all · that should be · all · complete

meaning.en: Everything needed is available.
meaning.zh: 应有的全都有了。

examples.zh: 这家超市生活用品一应俱全。
examples.en: This supermarket has every household item you need.

examples.zh: 酒店设施一应俱全。
examples.en: The hotel is fully equipped.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于商店、设施。

meaning.en: Unlike others; distinctive.
meaning.zh: 和大家不一样。

examples.zh: 她的穿着总是与众不同。
examples.en: Her style is always out of the ordinary.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅的装修与众不同。
examples.en: The restaurant's decor is unlike any other.

examples.zh: 每个孩子都是与众不同的。
examples.en: Every child is one of a kind.

usage.zh: 多含褒义。

meaning.en: So shocking that it alarms anyone who sees it.
meaning.zh: 看到某种严重情况而内心震惊。

examples.zh: 灾区的景象触目惊心。
examples.en: The scenes in the disaster zone were shocking.

examples.zh: 这些污染数据触目惊心。
examples.en: These pollution figures are alarming.

examples.zh: 事故现场触目惊心。
examples.en: The accident scene was horrifying.

usage.en: Predicate; news reports of disasters and abuses.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于报道灾难、问题。

meaning.en: Not unique: a similar case also exists.
meaning.zh: 不止一个，还有可以成对的。

examples.zh: 无独有偶，另一所学校也发生了类似的事。
examples.en: Coincidentally, something similar happened at another school.

examples.zh: 他喜欢集邮，无独有偶，他妻子也是。
examples.en: He collects stamps — and so, as it happens, does his wife.

usage.en: Usually a sentence-initial linking phrase, often about bad news.
usage.zh: 多放句首作连接，常用于贬义的事。

meaning.en: Shown to work in practice.
meaning.zh: 实行起来有成效。

examples.zh: 这是一种行之有效的学习方法。
examples.en: This is a tried and tested way to study.

examples.zh: 我们要找出行之有效的解决办法。
examples.en: We need to find solutions that actually work.

usage.en: Attributive: 行之有效的方法 / 措施.
usage.zh: 多作定语：行之有效的方法（措施）。

meaning.en: Without realising; unconsciously.
meaning.zh: 没有意识到，没有察觉到。

examples.zh: 不知不觉，天已经黑了。
examples.en: Before we knew it, it was dark.

examples.zh: 聊着聊着，我不知不觉睡着了。
examples.en: Chatting away, I drifted off without realising.

examples.zh: 不知不觉中，孩子已经长大了。
examples.en: Before you know it, the child has grown up.

usage.en: Very common sentence opener and adverbial.
usage.zh: 极常用，作状语或句首。

meaning.en: The overall trend that cannot be resisted.
meaning.zh: 整个局势发展的必然趋向。

examples.zh: 新能源汽车取代燃油车是大势所趋。
examples.en: Electric cars replacing petrol cars is inevitable.

examples.zh: 数字化转型已是大势所趋。
examples.en: Digital transformation is the way things are heading.

usage.zh: 多作谓语：……是大势所趋。

meaning.en: Countless households; everyone.
meaning.zh: 许许多多的人家。

examples.zh: 互联网已经走进了千家万户。
examples.en: The internet has reached every household.

examples.zh: 春节的饺子香飘千家万户。
examples.en: At Spring Festival the smell of dumplings fills homes everywhere.

usage.zh: 常说“走进千家万户”。

meaning.en: Still frightened after the danger has passed.
meaning.zh: 危险过去以后，心里还感到害怕。

examples.zh: 想起那场车祸，她至今心有余悸。
examples.en: Thinking back to the crash, she's still shaken.

examples.zh: 经历过地震的人，提起来仍心有余悸。
examples.en: Earthquake survivors still tremble when they talk about it.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“至今”“仍”连用。

meaning.en: Impossible to know.
meaning.zh: 无法知道。

examples.zh: 事故的原因目前还不得而知。
examples.en: The cause of the accident is not yet known.

examples.zh: 他为什么辞职，我们不得而知。
examples.en: Why he resigned, we have no way of knowing.

usage.zh: 书面，多作谓语。

meaning.en: Too eager or anxious to wait.
meaning.zh: 急迫得不能再等待。

examples.zh: 孩子们迫不及待地打开了礼物。
examples.en: The children tore open their presents eagerly.

examples.zh: 我迫不及待想见到你。
examples.en: I can't wait to see you.

examples.zh: 比赛还没开始，球迷们已经迫不及待了。
examples.en: The match hadn't started, but the fans were already impatient.

usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语。

meaning.en: Extremely urgent; about to happen.
meaning.zh: 形容事情临近眼前，十分紧迫。

examples.zh: 治理污染已经迫在眉睫。
examples.en: Tackling pollution has become extremely urgent.

examples.zh: 考试迫在眉睫，他却还在玩游戏。
examples.en: The exam is imminent, yet he's still playing games.

usage.zh: 多作谓语。

meaning.en: Rising and falling in succession; continuous.
meaning.zh: 这里起来，那里落下，连续不断。

examples.zh: 掌声此起彼伏。
examples.en: The applause rose and fell in waves.

examples.zh: 鞭炮声此起彼伏，过年的气氛很浓。
examples.en: Firecrackers went off one after another, full of New Year spirit.

examples.zh: 各地抗议此起彼伏。
examples.en: Protests broke out one after another across the country.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于声音、事件。

meaning.en: Unexpected; not anticipated.
meaning.zh: 没有预料到。

examples.zh: 这件事带来了意想不到的结果。
examples.en: This led to unexpected results.

examples.zh: 真是意想不到，我们在这儿遇见了。
examples.en: What a surprise to run into each other here!

usage.zh: 多作定语。

meaning.en: Not to be excessively criticised; understandable.
meaning.zh: 不能过分指责，表示虽有缺点但可以理解。

examples.zh: 为自己争取利益，本来无可厚非。
examples.en: Standing up for your own interests is perfectly understandable.

examples.zh: 年轻人追求时尚无可厚非。
examples.en: There's nothing wrong with young people following fashion.

story.en: Wang Mang dismissed the official Feng Ying for criticising him, but later relented: 'Ying is not to be too heavily blamed either' (英亦未可厚非).
story.zh: 王莽免去冯英的官职，后来醒悟，说：“英亦未可厚非。”

usage.en: Often with 本来/也. Not the same as 无可非议 'beyond reproach'.
usage.zh: 常与“本来”“也”连用，与“无可非议”不同。
